lines.speaker: riku
lines.text: STOP BREATHING [beat] EVERY SECOND YOU INHALE IS REMOVING TEN MINUTES FROM YOUR ENTIRE LIFE SPAN!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: The vents are literally glowing red [beat] and I can hear the sub-basement fans grinding against the metal floor!

lines.speaker: tuli
lines.text: We need to find the manual override [beat] but grandpa’s old schematics say the lever is hidden behind the main circuit breaker!

lines.speaker: riku
lines.text: It’s not just a purge [beat] the system is actually rewriting the entire security protocol to lock us in here forever!

lines.speaker: joy
lines.text: I found a hatch near the ceiling [beat] but it’s welded shut and there’s some kind of liquid leaking from the hinges!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: That’s not liquid [beat] that’s the liquid nitrogen coolant used to freeze the old attic records before they’re shredded!

lines.speaker: riku
lines.text: The temperature is dropping forty degrees every minute [beat] and my fingers are starting to turn completely blue!

lines.speaker: tuli
lines.text: Grab that heavy wrench from the toolbox [beat] if we can’t open the hatch we’ll have to smash through the ventilation shaft!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Wait [beat] look at the screen on the wall [beat] it’s showing a live feed of Grandpa watching us from the living room!

lines.speaker: riku
lines.text: He’s just sitting there drinking tea [beat] while we’re literally being erased from the family database by a vacuum!

lines.speaker: joy
lines.text: The pressure is building up so much [beat] that the glass on the sensors is starting to spiderweb and crack!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: If this glass breaks [beat] the entire sub-basement will implode and we’ll be crushed into the size of a soda can!

lines.speaker: riku
lines.text: The countdown just hit zero [beat] and I can hear the giant hydraulic press moving toward the center of the room!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The floor is opening up [beat] and whatever is underneath that metal grating is definitely not meant for human eyes.
